description: Toybox 10K farm animals, babies and small pets. GENERATED by tools/gen_tk_farm_pets.mjs (edit it and rerun, not this JSON): goat (+ goat_straw_hat, goat_neckerchief, goat_bell), the babies puppy, kitten, cousin_kitten, duckling, foal, calf (derived from dog, cat, duck, horse, cow), ox, yak, water_buffalo, mule (variant of horse), llama (+ grandma_llama), rat, hamster, guinea_pig.

goat.description: A friendly white toy goat, about 1.1 m tall to the horn tips at size 1: small cream horns curving back, a little tan beard, sideways ears with pink insides, big brown eyes, a pink nose, a perky tail and four legs on dark hooves. Faces +z. Named parts: horns, beard, ears (twitch on their own), tail (flicks on its own), leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (turn [±25, 0, 0] about x to trot or gallop on the spot). Dressed-up variants: goat_straw_hat (gardener's straw hat, part hat), goat_neckerchief (sailor's red neckerchief, part neckerchief) and goat_bell (a bell on a red collar, part bell: use size 0.7 / 0.85 / 1 for little, middle and big billy goats).

goat_straw_hat.description: The goat as a gardener: a wide golden straw hat with a red band sits over its horns (named part hat). All the goat's named parts and legs.

goat_neckerchief.description: The goat as a sailor: a red neckerchief knotted at the front of its neck (named part neckerchief). Hold a small flag prop at its front hoof to wave it. All the goat's named parts and legs.

goat_bell.description: The goat with a gold bell on a red collar (named part bell, swings gently). For the three billy goats use size 0.7, 0.85 and 1. All the goat's named parts and legs.

puppy.description: A tiny young puppy (the catalog dog's baby), about 0.7 m tall at size 1: a cream coat with a white chest, floppy brown ears, a brown patch round its left eye, big paws, big brown eyes and a waggy tail. Faces +z. Named part: tail (wags fast on its own).

kitten.description: A tiny fluffy gray kitten (the catalog cat's baby), about 0.6 m tall at size 1: soft gray fur with a white chest and muzzle, pointy ears with pink insides, big teal eyes and a short tail. Faces +z. Named part: tail (swishes on its own). Pair with a ribbon prop to pounce.

cousin_kitten.description: Cat's cousin kitten: the kitten in a ginger stripy coat with a cream chest and green eyes, and a little blue bow on its head (named part bow). Same size and named parts as kitten.

duckling.description: A small fluffy yellow duckling (the catalog duck's baby), about 0.6 m tall at size 1: a round yellow body, a big head with a fluffy tuft, a flat orange bill that opens to talk, big brown eyes and little flapping wings. Faces +z. Named part: wing. Use several at size 0.6-1 for counting rows and swimming lines.

foal.description: A young foal (a pony, the catalog horse's baby), about 1.05 m tall to the ear tips at size 1: a sandy coat with a cream belly and muzzle, long slim wobbly legs on dark hooves, a short fluffy brown mane and tail and big brown eyes. Faces +z. Named parts: tail, mane, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (turn [±25, 0, 0] about x to trot and prance). Talks with its own mouth.

calf.description: A small young calf (the catalog cow's baby), about 0.85 m tall at size 1: black-and-white like its mom, tiny cream horn buds, a black tuft, a pink snout, big brown eyes and knobbly-kneed legs on dark hooves. Faces +z. Named parts: tail, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (turn [±20, 0, 0] about x to wobble and trot).

ox.description: A big gentle brown toy ox, about 1.25 m tall at size 1 and 1.4 m nose to tail: a broad body with a shoulder hump, a sandy belly and wide muzzle, short cream horns curving out and up, sideways ears, sleepy-kind brown eyes, thick legs on dark hooves and a tufted tail. Faces +z. Named parts: horns, ears, tail (swishes), leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (turn about x to plod). Chews: let it talk with no line, or nod its head.

yak.description: A shaggy, friendly dark-brown toy yak, about 1.3 m tall to the horn tips at size 1: long soft hair hanging almost to its hooves, a cream face patch and muzzle, short cream horns curving up, a fluffy forelock, a bushy tail and a gold bell on a red ribbon. Faces +z. Named parts: horns, ears, bell (swings on its own), tail, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (turn about x to plod; mostly hidden under the hair). Huffs: a small puff prop at the nose.

water_buffalo.description: A big gray toy water buffalo, about 1.2 m tall at size 1: a heavy body, a broad pale nose, wide dark horns that sweep out and back, droopy ears, thick brows that start in a bossy frown (a sad or worried feeling softens them into a sheepish smile) and thick legs on dark hooves. Faces +z. Named parts: horns, ears, tail, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (turn about x to walk).

mule.description: A friendly gray-brown toy mule (built on the catalog horse at 0.9 scale), about 1.55 m tall to the tips of its long upright ears: a gray coat, a pale muzzle and belly, a short dark mane and tail, big brown eyes and a gentle smile. Faces +z. Named parts: ears (long, twitch on their own), tail, mane, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (turn [±25, 0, 0] about x to walk; raise the front pair to hold a flute prop). Talks with its own mouth.

llama.description: A tall, gentle cream-and-brown toy llama, about 1.85 m tall to the ear tips at size 1: a fluffy cream body and long fluffy neck, brown patches, long curved banana ears with brown tips, a fluffy forelock, a tan muzzle, soft brown eyes with long lashes and slim legs on dark toes. Faces +z. Named parts: neck, ears (twitch), tail, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (turn about x to walk). The grown-up look grandma_llama adds a woven shawl and round glasses.

grandma_llama.description: Grandmother Llama: the llama with a small woven red shawl with a gold stripe round her shoulders (named part shawl) and round black glasses (named part glasses). Same named parts as llama.

rat.description: A small friendly brown toy rat, about 0.75 m tall at size 1 (bigger than the gray mouse, with a longer pointed snout): a brown body with a cream tummy, rounded pink ears, a pink nose with whiskers, big shiny eyes, little pink paws and a long pink curling tail. Faces +z. Named parts: ears, paw (both front paws), tail (sways on its own), nose (wiggle it to sniff).

hamster.description: A small round golden toy hamster, about 0.5 m tall at size 1: one round body-head with a cream tummy and face, big puffed-out stuffed cheeks, tiny round ears with pink insides, shiny black eyes, a pink nose and tiny pink paws held up in front. Faces +z. Named parts: paw (both; raise one to wave, or use point), ears, cheeks (puff them: scale), feet.

guinea_pig.description: A small round toy guinea pig, about 0.42 m tall and 0.6 m long at size 1: a plump loaf body with ginger-and-white patches, a white blaze down the face, tiny petal ears, shiny black eyes, a pink nose, tiny pink feet and no tail. Faces +z. Named parts: ears, feet. Squeaks 'wheek wheek' when happy: make it hop with a small bounce.
